commitResults.messageTitle: AGENTS.md: Update student profile with experience and IDE
Rename project and main class from Duke to Bob
commitResults.messageBody:
"Duke" was the temporary name across the codebase and documentation. Renamed to "Bob"

Let's:
* Rename Duke.java to Bob.java and update class declaration
* Update project title and references in top-level README.md and docs/README.md
* Update the ASCII art banner to reflect the name "Bob"

commitResults.messageTitle: Add echo feature and exit on bye
Add marking and unmarking tasks feature
Add task types and input validation

commitResults.messageBody:
Document the project's style hierarchy, Codex workflow, and
validation expectations for future development.

Add reusable prompts for planning, implementing, reviewing, and
debugging project changes, and update the README and UI test plan
for the Gradle-based workflow.

Save the current task list to data/Bob.txt after every successful add, mark, unmark, and delete operation. Document the save behavior and verified console workflow in the UI test plan; loading and error handling remain for later increments.

Read serialized tasks from data/Bob.txt when Bob starts.

Reconstruct todo, deadline, and event tasks while preserving their completion
status. Update the UI test plan with file fixtures and startup-loading coverage.

Add graceful handling for missing, malformed, unreadable, and unwritable task
data files.

Start with an empty list when the data file is missing, report storage errors
without terminating Bob, and extend the UI test plan with error-case coverage.
